perUserLoss.maskingAnalysis: The 1000-wei term binds only where pre*bps/1e4 < 1000, i.e. USDC positions < 5 USDC and 18-dec positions < 5e6 wei. The most it can hide beyond the old bound is 998 wei per user: 0.000998 USDC, or ~1e-15 DOLA/USDe. Across 29 users that is < $0.03. The bps term still binds every position of economic size. At this block, the live population would also pass with WEI_SLACK = 2; the 1000 is needed for the planted-dust vector (L-01), not for today's stakers.
